'''Zane Thorp'''<ref name="dt-21041">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21041 It is about damn time we got our revenge], DeckTech (Zane "Godzanet" Thorp, 31 January 2002). == Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 6 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]]s name Zane Thorp (6 original concept credits).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards are in [[Virtual Block 5]] and [[Virtual Set 1]], sets dated 2009–2015 on this wiki. The concept credits also name the event or award the concept came from: Texas States 2004 (6 cards). The full list of everyone credited is at [[Card Credits#Zane Thorp|Card Credits]].
